text_blocks.snippet: Common and serious side effects of Opsumit (macitentan) range from everyday cold-like symptoms to major health risks that require medical attention.
snippet_highlighted_words: everyday cold-like symptoms to major health risks that require medical attention

list.snippet: Nasal and throat irritation: Stuffy nose, runny nose, or sore throat (nasopharyngitis).
Headaches: Mild to moderate head pain.
Bronchitis: Irritation or inflammation of the airways.
Anemia: Low red blood cell count, which can cause pale skin, unusual tiredness, or weakness.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Pain or burning during urination or frequent urges to go.
Flu-like symptoms: Fever, chills, or general body aches.
Fluid retention and swelling: Swelling in the hands, legs, ankles, or feet (peripheral edema), or rapid weight gain, often occurring in the first few weeks.
Liver problems: Elevated liver enzymes or signs of liver damage, such as yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice), dark urine, or upper right stomach pain.
Decreased sperm counts: Reduction in sperm production, which can cause male infertility.
Severe birth defects: Opsumit causes major harm to an unborn baby if taken during pregnancy.

text_blocks.snippet: You can read more about safety guidelines and precautions through the Official Opsumit Website or the Pulmonary Hypertension Association.
